{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter out rows where customer_age is -1 (missing)
df_filtered = df[df['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute mean age on filtered data
mean_age = df_filtered['customer_age'].mean()

# Print result
print(f"Mean age (excluding -1 values): {mean_age}")"}
